_note: Copy to ~/.claude/token-usage/prices.json. The mod already ships a price table (prices.default.json, with its date); use this file only to add a model it lacks or to override a price. Your entry for a model replaces the shipped one whole. Prices are per `per` tokens (default 1000000), in USD, from your provider's own pricing page; nothing in this example is a real price. A model with no input or output rate anywhere is counted in tokens but left unpriced. cached and cacheWrite default to the input rate, cacheWrite1h to the cacheWrite rate, thinking to the output rate. longPrompt: rates for calls whose prompt (input + cached + cacheWrite + cacheWrite1h) is above `above` tokens, for the whole call. effective: [{ from: 'YYYY-MM-DD', ...rates }] changes the rates from that UTC day on. note: free text.
